structure.label: Timeline
structure.prompt: Content is arranged along time. Now is a visible place on screen, and past and future are treated differently.

structure.label: Ledger
structure.prompt: Rows and columns of record. The table is the interface and editing happens in place.

structure.label: Map
structure.prompt: A spatial canvas where position means something. The user moves through it instead of paging.

structure.label: Deck
structure.prompt: One card at a time from a stack. Progress means moving through the stack.

structure.label: Single object
structure.prompt: One central object fills the screen and changes state. Everything else attaches to it.

structure.label: Thread
structure.prompt: A running log where new things arrive at one end and history scrolls away from it.

structure.label: Index
structure.prompt: A directory or catalogue: grouped, alphabetised or coded, scanned and jumped through.

structure.label: Instrument panel
structure.prompt: Fixed gauges and readouts in stable positions. The state is read at a glance and nothing moves around.

structure.label: Document
structure.prompt: A long readable page. Headings give the structure and actions sit inline in the text.

structure.label: Board
structure.prompt: Columns of stages, and items move between them.

structure.label: Calendar grid
structure.prompt: A grid of fixed slots (hours, days or weeks) that content fills.

structure.label: Outline
structure.prompt: A nested outline. Expanding and collapsing is the main motion.

structure.label: Queue
structure.prompt: The next item is large and the rest wait in line. Finishing an item is the main act.

structure.label: Orbit
structure.prompt: Items are arranged around a central focus, with distance from it meaning importance or recency.

interaction.label: Direct manipulation
interaction.prompt: Drag, resize and edit things where they are, with few buttons.

interaction.label: Command
interaction.prompt: Keyboard first. A command line or palette is the main way in, and the screen shows results.

interaction.label: Browse
interaction.prompt: Scanning and filtering a large set. Selecting opens detail beside the set, not over it.

interaction.label: Guided
interaction.prompt: One decision per step, in sequence, with the next step always obvious.

interaction.label: Glance
interaction.prompt: Mostly read and rarely touched. The screen answers 'is everything fine?' in a second.

interaction.label: Compose
interaction.prompt: The user writes or builds something, and the tool stays out of the way until called.

interaction.label: Conversational
interaction.prompt: Requests in plain language, with replies that become editable objects instead of chat bubbles.

interaction.label: Gesture
interaction.prompt: Swipes, long presses and physical metaphors, with feedback carried by motion.

world.label: Departure board
world.prompt: Fixed columns, status as a single word, amber or white characters on black, rows that update in place.

world.label: Pharmacy label
world.prompt: Small dense type in strict fields, coloured warning bands, white paper, dosage units everywhere.

world.label: Topographic map
world.prompt: Contour lines, muted greens and browns, tiny italic labels, coordinates and a scale bar.

world.label: Lab notebook
world.prompt: Grid paper, numbered dated entries, annotations in blue ink and pencil grey, figures taped in.

world.label: Sewing pattern
world.prompt: Tissue-paper beige, overlapping outlines in different dash styles, cutting marks, size keys.

world.label: Seed packet
world.prompt: A bold colour block per category, an illustrated subject, a small planting chart grid on the back.

world.label: Museum wall label
world.prompt: Wide margins, a small precise serif, object metadata always in the same order.

world.label: Transit map
world.prompt: Coloured lines at fixed angles, interchange dots, one line colour per category, a legend.

world.label: Scoreboard
world.prompt: Huge tabular numerals, team colours, the period and clock always visible.

world.label: Hi-fi receiver
world.prompt: Brushed metal, a backlit dial scale, small engraved labels, one glowing indicator.

world.label: Card catalogue
world.prompt: Index cards, typewriter type, tab dividers, call numbers as identifiers.

world.label: Nautical chart
world.prompt: Small sounding numerals, pale blue depth bands, buoys as symbols, a compass rose.

world.label: Weather station
world.prompt: LCD segment digits, min and max pairs, trend arrows, pale grey-green housing.

world.label: Textbook diagram
world.prompt: Numbered callouts with leader lines, flat two-colour print, figure captions.

world.label: Blueprint
world.prompt: White linework on blue, dimension lines, a title block in the corner.

world.label: Letterpress poster
world.prompt: Wood type, two inks overprinting, uneven impression, stacked lines of different widths.

world.label: Patient chart
world.prompt: A clipboard grid, vitals as small charts, colour-coded tabs, fields for handwriting.

world.label: Herbarium sheet
world.prompt: One specimen on a large sheet, a small label block with collection number and date.

world.label: Race telemetry
world.prompt: Sector times, purple, green and yellow deltas, dense numerals, a position tower.

world.label: Shipping container
world.prompt: Stencil type, huge identification codes, safety orange, hazard marks used sparingly.

world.label: Almanac
world.prompt: Month columns, moon phases, small woodcut icons, ochre and green ink.

world.label: Radio log
world.prompt: Time-stamped rows, call signs and frequencies, carbon-copy blue on pale paper.

world.label: Board game
world.prompt: Chunky tokens, bright primaries, numbered spaces, a rulebook's headings and diagrams.

world.label: Field guide
world.prompt: Plates of illustrations, small range maps, compact identification marks and abbreviations.

world.label: Cockpit display
world.prompt: Black field, magenta and cyan symbols, tapes that scroll past a fixed pointer.

world.label: Knitting chart
world.prompt: A square grid with one symbol per cell, row numbers on both sides, a symbol key.

world.label: Auction catalogue
world.prompt: Lot numbers, estimate ranges, plate photographs, small caps for provenance.

world.label: Stamp sheet
world.prompt: Perforated edges, denominations, fine engraved linework, one strong colour per stamp.

world.label: Shelf labels
world.prompt: A large price, a small unit price, yellow promotion tags, barcodes and codes.

world.label: Contact sheet
world.prompt: Rows of film frames, frame numbers in the rebate, grease-pencil circles and crosses.

world.label: Strata column
world.prompt: Layered bands with hatch patterns, a depth scale, labels on leader lines.

world.label: Activity book
world.prompt: Thick outlines, bright flat fills, dotted trace lines, big friendly numbers.

world.label: Ticket stub
world.prompt: A perforation, gate, row and seat fields, serial numbers, thermal-print type.

world.label: Tile catalogue
world.prompt: Swatches in a strict grid, glaze names and code numbers, fired earth tones.

world.label: Watch dial
world.prompt: Subdials, fine tick marks, engraved numerals, a single luminous accent.

world.label: Synth panel
world.prompt: Knobs and patch points, tiny uppercase labels, colour-coded cables, sections ruled off.

world.label: Tide table
world.prompt: Columns of times and heights, small wave curves, sea green, high and low marked.

world.label: Election night
world.prompt: Bold category colours on a map, seat counts, bars racing toward a threshold line.

world.label: Trail signage
world.prompt: Routed wood or enamel signs, distance and time to each destination, coloured waymarks.

world.label: Pill organiser
world.prompt: A row of compartments by day, translucent colours, raised letters, open and closed states.

world.label: Atlas gazetteer
world.prompt: Grid references like B4, gazetteer columns, tiny place-name type, page tabs.

density.label: Sparse
density.prompt: Few elements and large type. One thing matters per screen.

density.label: Balanced
density.prompt: Primary content gets room; secondary detail stays visible but small.

density.label: Dense
density.prompt: Information-rich, with small type and tight rows. Everything is visible without drilling in.

color.label: Dominant field
color.prompt: One strong colour covers most of the screen and content sits on it.

color.label: Achromatic plus signal
color.prompt: Black, white and greys, with a single colour that only ever means 'needs attention'.

color.label: Multihue key
color.prompt: Several colours that each stand for a category, used consistently like a map key.

color.label: Image-led
color.prompt: Real photography or illustration carries the colour and the UI stays neutral.

color.label: Tinted neutrals
color.prompt: The whole palette leans toward one hue such as paper, slate or moss, at low saturation with no pure grey.

color.label: Luminous data
color.prompt: A dark field where the data carries the light in several hues and the chrome nearly disappears.

color.label: Two-ink print
color.prompt: Exactly two inks plus the paper, with overlaps making a third.

type.label: Condensed grotesk
type.prompt: A condensed grotesk at large sizes, with tabular numerals for data.

type.label: Humanist sans
type.prompt: A humanist sans throughout; warmth comes from the letterforms rather than from colour.

type.label: Text serif
type.prompt: A text serif for content and a small sans for controls.

type.label: Rounded sans
type.prompt: A rounded sans with soft weights and generous letter spacing at small sizes.

type.label: Extended sans
type.prompt: A wide, extended sans for headings and a compact face for body text.

type.label: Slab serif
type.prompt: A sturdy slab serif with a printed feel.

type.label: Single family
type.prompt: One family only, with hierarchy made entirely by size and weight.

type.label: Mono for data
type.prompt: A monospace face for every value and code, set against a proportional face for words.

wild.label: No navigation
wild.prompt: Remove the navigation. Everything happens on one surface.

wild.label: Spatial
wild.prompt: Users move through the content in space instead of scrolling a list.

wild.label: One at full size
wild.prompt: Only one item is ever shown at full size; the rest stay ambient around it.

wild.label: Type only
wild.prompt: Typography carries everything: no icons, no boxes, no dividers.

wild.label: Time first
wild.prompt: Time is the primary axis even if the product doesn't look time-based.

wild.label: Result first
wild.prompt: The default view is the finished result; editing is the exception the user opens.

wild.label: Inverted hierarchy
wild.prompt: What most apps in this category hide in settings or detail becomes the main screen.

wild.label: One gesture
wild.prompt: One physical gesture or drag is the main action of the whole product.
